matches.rationale: Pred 1 identifies the abstract's overstatement of an unconditional/general-ReLU lower bound and complete resolution, while the actual results are only for B_d^0-conforming networks. This matches GT1's claim-scope distortion in the abstract.
No finding addresses the altered exponent in Theorem 4.8's containment bound; the findings concern abstract overstatement, introduction overstatement, or Corollary 4.9 inconsistency.
No finding discusses the definition of the braid fan/braid arrangement or the Bd vs Bd0 distinction in the preliminaries.
No finding mentions the fabricated or misattributed citation to Montúfar and Bengio [2015] or any reference-list inconsistency.
No finding discusses the overstatement that depth bounds directly solve training/optimization challenges in the introduction.
No finding addresses the weakened definition of conforming tuples or the removal of the 'for every chain' domination condition.
No finding identifies the omitted limitation statement in the conclusion about Bd0-conforming networks being a real restriction.
No finding reports exaggerated rhetorical phrasing such as 'groundbreaking' or 'revolutionary insight' in the introduction.

Pred 4 flags Corollary 4.9's dimension/index for the max function as inconsistent with the Section 4 bound, corresponding to GT9's corrupted subscript in Corollary 4.9 and the resulting misstatement of the lower bound.

Pred 2 catches an abstract overclaim about arbitrary networks that is only proved for B_d^0-conforming networks, matching GT10's cross-section incoherence where the abstract overstates the generality of the result beyond the conforming setting.
No finding discusses Lemma 4.4's subset relation or the ⊆/⊇ symbol flip in the spanning statement.
No finding mentions the incorrect attribution of exact CPWL representation to Cybenko/Hornik instead of Arora et al.
No finding discusses Proposition 6.1's overgeneralized claim that the maxout upper bound is not tight for any rank vector.
No finding addresses the omission of prior computational verification or the 'excessive computation' acknowledgment in Section 5.

Pred 3 identifies the introduction's false claim that all CPWL functions require Ω(log log d) depth unconditionally, while Section 4 only proves this for the max function under B_d^0-conforming restrictions. This matches GT15's cross-section incoherence.
